scope: Four review findings fixed with generic collector/renderer/session rules; 10 public pages sampled in original, bilingual top, PageDown and replace views; Chrome native extension and Firefox fresh Gecko content harness regressions.
fixes: Independent flex text items remain in their original columns; single existing labels are reused without moving source elements.
Later translations register as owners of active height/media rules even when the rule already prevents overflow.
Owned flow wrappers are unwrapped at their current page location, including wrapping, transfer and removed original hosts.
Code-boundary attribute changes invalidate the actual source owner, including original nodes in replace-mode stashes; existing editor animation does not invalidate adjacent prose.
